description: Specification for the Generalized Matrix Chain Optimizer. Defines structural property propagation rules and the FLOP cost model for matrix multiplications.

propagation_rules.description: When computing C = A * B, the structural property of C is determined by the properties of A and B. Rules are checked in order; the first matching rule determines the result property. If no specific rule matches, the result is 'general'.

cost_model.description: FLOP cost for computing C = A * B, where A is m x k and B is k x n. Rules are checked in priority order; the first applicable rule determines the cost.

rules.condition: Both A and B are diagonal
A is diagonal (B is any non-diagonal)
rules.explanation: Scale each row of B by the corresponding diagonal entry of A

rules.condition: B is diagonal (A is any non-diagonal)
rules.explanation: Scale each column of A by the corresponding diagonal entry of B

rules.condition: A or B is structured (symmetric, upper_triangular, or lower_triangular)
rules.explanation: Exploit structure of one operand (e.g., DSYMM, DTRMM) for ~2x savings over DGEMM

rules.condition: Both A and B are general (no exploitable structure)
